top_findings.title: Clean Crawlability & Strong HTTP Security
top_findings.description: Robots.txt explicitly allows standard and AI crawlers with full sitemap index. Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), nosniff, and SAMEORIGIN headers active on Vercel Edge.

top_findings.title: Dual llms.txt & Rich Entity Mapping
top_findings.description: Standardized token-budgeted llms.txt and llms-full.txt with text/plain UTF-8 delivery, discoverable by ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity browsing agents.

top_findings.title: Comprehensive Schema.org Graph
top_findings.description: Fully connected Person, WebSite, ProfilePage, and 4 SoftwareApplication entries (OK OCE EventIT, IronPixels, Oit, Slop Dungeon) without deprecated HowTo or FAQPage schemas.

top_findings.title: Semantic Screen-Reader and Non-WebGL HTML Fallback
top_findings.description: SR-only main container provides comprehensive semantic HTML5 markup for search engines without executing WebGL shaders.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows major search and AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
sitemap.xml valid and discoverable with lastmod and changefreq
Vercel Edge CDN headers: HSTS 2-year preload, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy
Canonical link tag matches current production domain exactly
Google Search Console verification meta present and verified
Dedicated public/404.html error handling

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header Optimization
findings.description: vercel.json configures HSTS and frame options, but adding a defined CSP header would harden browser security against potential script injections.
findings.recommendation: Configure a strict CSP policy in vercel.json allowing unsafe-inline for speculation rules and trusted script sources.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data

Rich entity details: alternateName, address, nationality, alumniOf, worksFor, sameAs, knowsAbout

findings.title: ProfilePage dateModified Synchronization
findings.description: dateModified in JSON-LD is set to 2026-10-31, which should be bumped to the latest revision date (2026-11-03).

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Immediate initial paint via styled loading screen and animated HUD
Preloading top 3 critical above-the-fold textures (default.jpg, ironpixels_preview.png, oit_preview.png)
Zero layout shifts (CLS < 0.05) due to fixed viewport WebGL canvas and absolute positioning
Smooth 60 FPS requestAnimationFrame loop with debounced camera interactions

findings.title: Large JavaScript Bundle Chunk (> 680 kB uncompressed)
findings.description: Vite build outputs a single large index JS chunk of 684 kB containing Three.js, GSAP, and all scene components.
findings.recommendation: Consider code-splitting non-critical sub-components or utilizing manualChunks in vite.config.js for vendor libraries.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: Standardized llms.txt and llms-full.txt served with correct MIME type (text/plain; charset=utf-8)
Link rel='alternate' type='text/markdown' in HTML head for AI discovery
Speculation rules prefetching /llms.txt for near-instant retrieval
Full citation clarity with unambiguous identity mapping between Felix Palingan and Almakius Felix Bariq Hekopung

findings.title: Agent Discovery Manifest (ai-catalog.json)
findings.description: While llms.txt is complete, adding an ai-catalog.json or /.well-known discovery file provides structured metadata for autonomous agents.
findings.recommendation: Optionally generate public/ai-catalog.json outlining application capabilities and endpoints.

categories.name: Images & Media
what_works: Open Graph preview image supplied at 1864x928 with explicit width/height tags
Dual format favicons (SVG and PNG)
Preloaded above-the-fold textures

findings.title: Uncompressed JPEG Assets (slop_dungeon_logo.jpg & default.jpg)
findings.description: default.jpg is 213 kB and slop_dungeon_logo.jpg is 382 kB. Converting them to modern WebP format will reduce network payload by over 60%.
findings.recommendation: Convert images to WebP format with 85% quality compression.
